notes.title: Post your dishes to the in-game social media!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i7XFfF75ORw;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that [b]“Debut Project: Cooking Café”[/b] is now available for purchase on Steam!! Purchase during the first 7 days of launch to receive [b]10% off![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/421989aa63277512ba504860987d93448ce1d3e5.jpg[/img]
[h3]Post your dishes to the in-game social media![/h3]
Check out the comments from your followers and see how many [b]“Likes”[/b] your dishes get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/ee48d2caea854c6e40822500009064e4ff3d2cb7.jpg[/img]
The more “Likes” you get, the higher your [b]“Flavor Rank”[/b] will be, allowing you to try new dishes!

As you continue to cook the same dish, its [b]“Mastery Level”[/b] will increase, unlocking new menus and toppings of the dish for even more variety.

You can also participate in [b]“Hashtag Challenges”[/b] by creating dishes that match the given hashtags, or even create your own original menu!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155560/

notes.title: “Debut Project: Cooking Café” AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i7XFfF75ORw;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that [b]“Debut Project: Cooking Café”[/b] is now available for purchase on Steam!! Purchase during the first 7 days of launch to receive [b]10% off![/b]

Players will take on the role of a new café employee, taking orders from customers, completing missions, and creating visually appealing dishes perfect for social media.

It's a cooking game where you post the dishes you've made on the in-game social media, aiming for a million followers by getting "Likes" and improving your store's rating.

[h3]80 different dishes you can make![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33518623/68b57e8ae3059094f48d2a28aa3294eed61e68d5.jpg[/img]

You can experience making dishes like pancakes, crepes, hamburg steak, cakes, and Omurice through [b]13 different minigames[/b].

Enjoy creating stylish and photogenic dishes by swirling soft serve ice cream onto a cone, drawing pictures on pancakes with sauce, and customizing your creations with [b]271 different toppings[/b].

There are [b]80 dishes[/b] in total that you can make! Let's try making various kinds of dishes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155560/
